prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: production favicon for the existing AI and Learning / EduForum presentation website.
Primary request: Create one distinctive minimal favicon combining an open book and a single small four-point spark, expressing learning with artificial intelligence.
Scene/backdrop: A dark charcoal (#18181b) rounded-square tile, with genuinely transparent pixels outside its rounded corners.
Subject: Two bold geometric teal (#2dd4bf) page shapes forming an open book; a single warm orange (#fb923c) four-point spark above the centre of the book. Treat this as one unified compact emblem.
Style/medium: Crisp flat graphic, vector-like precision, solid fills, polished and restrained.
Composition/framing: Square image, straight-on, one centered icon. The charcoal tile should occupy nearly the full canvas, with only a 4% transparent outside margin. The book fills about 70% of the tile width. Generous separation between book and spark, strong silhouette, substantial shapes that remain clear when reduced to 16x16 and 32x32 pixels.
Constraints: Exactly one favicon, no variations or presentation board. No text, no letters, no wordmark, no tiny details, no outlines thinner than a page stem. No gradients, no texture, no shading, no 3D, no mockup, no watermark. Real transparent background outside the tile.
